title: pteris scandens
intro: Pteris scandens, commonly known as the climbing fern, is a type of perennial fern that belongs to the Pteris genus. The health benefits of Pteris scandens include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Pteris scandens contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
